item.title: Ask HN: Why is HN missing a "go to top" link on long posts?
item.summary: Im wondering nearly every day: Is there maybe a reason HN does not have that typical "go to top" or "to top" link at the end of, at least very long, posts? Maybe we can file a change request @dang :-D Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49392170 Points: 1 # Comments: 1
